rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: The Council's archive of royal speeches for the first year of the first term (1414-1415 AH) prints King Fahd's words after the oath was taken, then the speech of 'the Chairman of the Shura Council, Sheikh محمد بن ابراهيم بن جبير', which ends by inviting the King to deliver his address opening the Council's work in its new form; the King's address that follows says 'we open today the Shura Council in its new framework'.
rows.locator: Headings كلمة خادم الحرمين الشريفين بعد الانتهاء من أداء القسم; كلمة معالي رئيس مجلس الشورى الشيخ/ محمد بن ابراهيم بن جبير; الخطاب السامي لخادم الحرمين الشريفين

bounded_scope: Chair observations for CLAUDE-C01-25 only (sa_shura_chair and sa_succession_chair). Appointment orders, stated effective days, stated first days in office, oaths, council-formation orders, term starts and openings, acting presiding, deaths, translations, republications and in-office attestations stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. The C01-06 king, crown-prince and prime-minister roles are outside this extract.
